author: Nerd of the Rings
description:
Time for a deep dive into the potential lore references and storylines of Season 3 of The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power!  We got our first look during SDCC Hall H and I've got a LOT of thoughts on what seems to be a much darker tone for the show with things like the ringwraiths, Sauron forging the ring, and...from the panel...a talking balrog!

Art featured:
The Forging of the One - Ted Nasmith
The Forging of the Ring - Alan Lee
Endgame on the Mountain - Ted Nasmith
Menegroth - David_Greset
The royal court of thingol - steamey
Celeborn and Galadriel in Doriath - AnotherStranger- Me
making the girdle of melian - steamey
Nazgul Bowing Before Sauron - Kip Rasmussen
The Nine Kings - Anato Finnstark
Ar_pharazon - steamey
Elros Tar-Minyatur - Ralph Damiani
Amon Sul2 - Anato Finnstark
The keeper of one of the nine rings - steamey

Desert city sunset - Felix Englund
Finwë heraldic device - J.R.R. Tolkien
Star of the House of Feanor - J.R.R. Tolkien
Luthi
title: The Rings of Power Season 3 Teaser BREAKDOWN
